What hunters ask about this unit

Written from the queries the page already receives, answered in the first sentence.

Can I hunt Unit 61 elk without drawing a tag?
Yes, through a Colorado landowner voucher (LPP): the voucher transfers the tag to you, and you still buy the licence and habitat stamp that go with it. The draw is the other route, and at under 1% for nonresidents it is the slower one.
What does under 1% actually mean for me?
It means applying is a long-term plan and not a season plan — most applicants accumulate points for years and still do not draw. If your hunt has a date on it, the voucher is the mechanism that respects the date.
What if nothing is listed for my unit?
Set the alert on this page. You get one email the day a verified tag lands in the unit, and nothing else. The same alert count is what tells a rancher there is demand here while they are deciding whether to list.
Is the price on this page the price I pay?
The listing price is the price you are quoted. Nothing on this domain takes payment; the sale transacts on LandownerTags, where funds are held until the tag is verified.

Ask a person.

This unit is handled by Jimmy Horton. Whoever picks up can open the listing record while you are on the line — including the row you are looking at.
